The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''33,908 before the Battle of Yavin''', also known as '''2,545 after the Tho Yor Arrival''', was a year in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic history]]. That year, a member of the [[Je'daii Order]] was recorded saying the phrase "At the heart of any poor soul not at one with the Force, there is only void." Though the Je'daii's identity was lost to history, the phrase itself endured as a common saying in the Je'daii Order.<ref name="DOTJ">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>
